name: Trade Data 45
definition: Provides information on the status of a trade.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Identification of the present message assigned by the party issuing the message. This identification must be unique amongst all messages of same type sent by the same party.

StatusOriginator.name: Status Originator
StatusOriginator.definition: Party that assigned the status to the foreign exchange trade.

CurrentStatus.name: Current Status
CurrentStatus.definition: Specifies the new status of the trade.

CurrentStatusSubType.name: Current Status Sub Type
CurrentStatusSubType.definition: Additional information about the current status of the trade.

CurrentStatusDateTime.name: Current Status Date Time
CurrentStatusDateTime.definition: Specifies the date and time at which the current status was assigned to all the trades, unless overwritten by a date and time assigned to an individual trade.

PreviousStatus.name: Previous Status
PreviousStatus.definition: Specifies the previous status of a trade.

PreviousStatusSubType.name: Previous Status Sub Type
PreviousStatusSubType.definition: Additional information on the previous status of a trade in a central system.

ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Specifies the product for which the status of the confirmation is reported, unless overwritten by a product type assigned to an individual trade.

SettlementSessionIdentifier.name: Settlement Session Identifier
SettlementSessionIdentifier.definition: To indicate the requested CLS settlement session that the related trade is part of.
